name: Qamar
about: Qamar is an Arabic and Urdu name meaning 'moon.' The word comes directly from Arabic qamar, giving the name a clear celestial association shared across Arabic-speaking and Urdu-speaking cultures. Elegant, atmospheric and quietly distinctive, Qamar is a gender-neutral choice with a strong connection to the night sky.

name: Qian
about: Qian is a Chinese name that can be written with different characters and therefore has several possible meanings. One documented form, 倩, carries the meaning 'handsome' or 'beautiful,' while other characters with the same pronunciation create different meanings. Refined, concise and culturally rich, Qian is a distinctive gender-neutral name with an elegant sound.

name: Qing
about: Qing is a Chinese gender-neutral name that can be written with several different characters. One documented form, 青, is associated with blue, green and youth, while other characters pronounced Qing can carry different meanings. Fresh, compact and evocative, Qing has a distinctly modern feel while remaining rooted in Chinese language and naming traditions.

name: Qiu
about: Qiu is a Chinese gender-neutral name with several possible written forms and meanings. The character 秋 means 'autumn,' while 丘 means 'hill' or 'mound'; the latter was also the given name of the philosopher Confucius. Distinctive and understated, Qiu connects seasonal imagery and landscape with a concise, elegant sound.

name: Quỳnh
about: Quỳnh is a Vietnamese gender-neutral name derived from the Sino-Vietnamese word quỳnh, associated with the colour deep red and with a flowering plant in the genus Epiphyllum. Its botanical connection gives the name a quiet natural beauty, while its established use in Vietnam makes it a distinctive choice with genuine cultural roots.

name: Quin
about: Quin is a rare English variant of Quinn, ultimately connected to the Irish surname Ó Cuinn and the given name Conn. Its shorter spelling gives it a particularly clean and minimalist character while retaining the established history of Quinn. Simple, distinctive and comfortably cross-gender, Quin is an understated alternative to the more familiar Quinn.

name: Quinn
about: Quinn comes from the Irish surname Ó Cuinn, an Anglicised form derived from the given name Conn. Once primarily encountered as a surname, Quinn developed into an established given name and is now used across genders. Familiar without feeling conventional, Quinn is a confident gender-neutral choice with strong Irish roots and a clean, memorable sound.

name: Quinlan
about: Quinlan originated as an Irish surname, an Anglicised form of Ó Caoindealbháin, which comes from the Old Irish given name Caoindealbhán. The surname tradition gives Quinlan a strong historical foundation, while its rare modern use as a given name gives it a distinctive, contemporary quality. Elegant and unusual, Quinlan is a striking gender-neutral choice with Celtic roots.

name: Quincy
about: Quincy developed from an English surname derived through the French place name Cuinchy from the Roman personal name Quintus. The name has a long history of use as a surname and given name, including the American statesman John Quincy Adams and musician Quincy Jones. Polished, recognisable and comfortably cross-gender, Quincy combines historical depth with a distinctly modern sound.

name: Quill
about: Quill is an uncommon English name associated with the feather pen traditionally used for writing. It is also documented as a diminutive of Aquilla, giving the name more than one possible naming history. With its strong connection to writing, literature and creativity, Quill has an imaginative character and works naturally as a distinctive gender-neutral word name.
